text:
Mia Chen: dropping a new compact 'model spend snapshot' card for the Usage & Billing dashboard. goal: show org context, top 3 models, and a quick invoice action without expanding. prototype: https://figma.redwood/model-snapshot-v1 :mag:
Devon Patel: looks clean. ops ask: make model USD visible in-line (no click). also support bulk invoice for selected projects from the same card
Raja Iyer: inline 3-row table works: Model | Tokens | USD. show +N overflow with a small flyout. mini-sparkline above rows for trend
Olivia Park: a11y: gray microcopy fails contrast at 14px. also ensure touch targets >=44px for mobile. aria roles needed for the flyout
Linh Tran: for bulk invoices we should make export async. large orgs will time out otherwise. UI should show job id + ETA and send a console notification when ready
Sam (PM): agree. UX note: on narrow widths collapse invoice CTA to icon + sr-only text; but keep explicit text label on desktop. users missed icon-only before
Mia Chen: compromise: icon + tooltip on hover + sr-only label for assistive tech. will update. also adding breadcrumb chip: [Org: redwood-inc] next to the scope toggle
Devon Patel: filename pattern request from finance: prefer dot-delimited for easy parsing: `redwood.inc.project-alpha.2025-03.invoice.csv` or maybe `redwood.inc.project-alpha.2025-03.invoice.zip` for batches
Raja Iyer: prefer underscore or hyphen to avoid dots in slugs. how about `redwood-inc_project-alpha_2025-03_invoice.csv`? we need a stable pattern for automation
Olivia Park: accessibility for download flow: announce via aria-live: "Invoice export started for 12 projects; you will be notified when ready." and on completion: "Invoice export for redwood-inc ready. Click to download."
Linh Tran: backend security: presigned URL should be short-lived and single-use. include a server manifest.json inside zips with checksums and a version field for parity checks
Mia Chen: adding manifest idea to designs. sample manifest snippet: ```json
{"version":"1.0","files":[{"name":"redwood-inc_project-alpha_2025-03_invoice.csv","sha256":"<hex>"}],"generated_by":"billing-service"}
```
Devon Patel: UX nit: when switching scope (org -> project) DO NOT reset date range. make date-range sticky per user so dashboards don't jump
Raja Iyer: overflow behavior: show top 3 projects inline with tiny bars, then open a lightweight modal for "+N" with search and checkboxes. modal must trap focus and restore focus on close
Olivia Park: modal checklist: role="dialog", aria-modal="true", initial focus on first checkbox, Escape closes, announce with aria-live when content loads. also ensure close button has aria-label="Close"
Sam (PM): prioritization for next release: 1) microcopy contrast to WCAG AA 2) visible invoice CTA for mobile 3) async batch export + manifest 4) date-range persistence. density toggle and stacked area chart are nice-to-have later
Mia Chen: will update prototype with contrast fixes, breadcrumb chip, icon+sr-only CTA, and manifest example. linking a tiny code example for Content-Disposition header to match filename: ```http
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="redwood-inc_project-alpha_2025-03_invoice.csv"
```
AuditBot: scan results: microcopy contrast ratio 0.39 FAIL. interactive flyout lacks aria-haspopup. recommend adding tabindex and visible focus styles to pills
Devon Patel: perf note: virtualize overflow list when >50 projects. render microbars on canvas for thousands of rows to avoid DOM thrash
Mia Chen: noted. I9ll push a revised Figma with these changes and post back here. thanks all :white_check_mark:
